ART.title: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa and Arabian perfume: a guide to the notes
ART.body:
Few perfumes have travelled by word of mouth like Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa. It belongs to a wave of Arabian perfume houses, from Lattafa and Afnan to Al Haramain, Arabiyat Prestige and Maison Alhambra, whose rich, warm scents have found a big following in the UK. Here is what is in Khamrah Qahwa, what makes a perfume "Arabian", and how to choose one.

What does Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa smell like?

"Qahwa" is the Arabic word for coffee, and that is the idea at the heart of Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum (£26.99, 100ml). Its notes, from top to base:

  • Top: cinnamon, cardamom and ginger, the spices of Arabic coffee.
  • Heart: praline, candied fruits and white flowers.
  • Base: coffee, vanilla, tonka bean, benzoin and musk.

So it opens spicy, turns sweet and nutty, and settles into coffee and vanilla. It is an amber-woody, gourmand scent made for men and women, and it suits cooler months and evenings best.

More from Lattafa

Lattafa perfume is known for warm, generous scents at friendly prices. Alongside Khamrah Qahwa, we list:

  • Lattafa Teriaq (£29.99): caramel, bitter almond, pink pepper and apricot, then honey, rhubarb and rose over leather, vanilla and musk. Unisex.
  • Lattafa Maahir Black Edition (£25.99): black and pink pepper with saffron, then labdanum and cade oil over leather, cedarwood, guaiac wood and patchouli. A darker, smoky choice.
  • Lattafa Yara Candy (£26.99): green mandarin and blackcurrant, a strawberry-candy and gardenia heart, and vanilla, musk and sandalwood. Made for women.

See every Lattafa scent on the Lattafa page.

Afnan, Arabiyat Prestige and Maison Alhambra

Afnan 9am Dive (£26.99) is the fresh one: lemon, mint, pink pepper and blackcurrant, then apple, incense and cedarwood. Afnan Supremacy Gold (£27.99) is warmer, with nutmeg, violet and peach blossom over amber, vanilla, oud and benzoin. More on the Afnan page.

Arabiyat Prestige Nyla (£25.99, 80ml) is a bright floral-fruity scent for women: coconut, peach and mandarin, then tiare, jasmine and rose over white musk. See Arabiyat Prestige. Maison Alhambra adds a wide range of floral, fruity and woody eau de parfums at friendly prices.

What makes a perfume "Arabian"?

There is no strict rule, but Arabian perfume usually leans on a few ingredients:

  • Oud (agarwood): a deep, woody, slightly smoky note.
  • Amber and resins such as benzoin and labdanum: warm and sweet.
  • Saffron, cardamom and cinnamon: spice.
  • Rose and musk: soft and rounded.

Most of the scents above are eau de parfum, which typically holds around 15–20% perfume oil. Read extrait vs eau de parfum for what each label means.

Arabian perfume in stock now

Warm and spicy

Al Haramain Amber Oud Tobacco Edition (£32.99, 60ml) shares Khamrah Qahwa's love of spice: tobacco leaf, cinnamon, black pepper and ginger, then vanilla, clove, star anise, cacao and tonka bean. Al Haramain Amber Oud Black Edition (£39.99) pairs cardamom and lavender with leather, amber and benzoin.

Sweet and fruity

Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (from £32.99) is bergamot, melon and pineapple over vanilla and musk, a popular first Arabian perfume. Al Haramain Amber Oud Ruby Edition (from £41.99) mixes saffron and bitter almond with jasmine and ambergris. Al Haramain Amber Musk (£39.99) is softer: amber, musk, vanilla and resins.

Oud and saffron

Fumeri Oud Saffron (£29.99) and SAP Saffron Oud Extrait de Parfum (£43.99) both open on saffron and spice before oud, cedarwood and smoky woods, with amber, leather and musk. Montale Aoud Safran (£54.99) builds on saffron and oud with rose and amber, while La Maison de la Vanille Royal Oud (£19.99) softens oud with Turkish rose and jasmine.

Browse all Arabian perfume and oud perfume.

How to wear a rich, warm perfume

  • Start small: one or two sprays on the neck or wrists. You can add more; you cannot take it away.
  • Spray on moisturised skin, so the scent has something to sit on. We explain how in how to layer oud with body butter.
  • Try it on skin before you decide. Warm notes change over the first hour, so judge the base, not just the first spray.
  • Patch test if your skin is sensitive to fragrance.

Arabian perfume also makes a generous gift: see our Christmas gift guide.

price-15-25.copy:
Our £15 to £25 edit is full of gifts under £25, with 108 products from designer perfume minis to natural body care. Many are everyday heroes you will reach for again and again. Every item is authentic and ships from the UK.

Fragrance at this price

Designer miniatures let you try a famous scent without a full bottle. Gucci Bloom Parfum 10ml Miniature Spray and Gucci Guilty Pour Femme 10ml are £19.99, and Calvin Klein Eternity, Defy and My Euphoria 10ml minis are £18.99 each. Hermès Un Jardin 15ml miniatures, at £24.99, make a lovely travel size perfume. Full bottles include Davidoff Champion Eau de Toilette at £23.99, Armaf Hunter at £22.99, and La Maison de la Vanille Royal Oud and Ambre Secret at £19.99. Jean Paul Gaultier Classique Perfumed Shower Gel, at £22.99, is a Jean Paul perfume treat for the shower.

Skin and body care

Deyga Chocolate Body Butter is a chocolate body butter at £15.99, and Deyga Body Scrub, a fruit-based body scrub, is £16.99. Deyga Charcoal Detox Face Mask and Activated Charcoal Body Wash are £15.99 each. Highborn London Crystal Cleanser at £24 and Superior Lip Butter (15ml) at £22.50 bring luxury English care into this band. Deyga Soft Lip Combo, at £17.99, is a small skincare gift set for lips.

For more ideas, see our gifts under £25 page, or move up to the £25 to £50 edit. Free UK delivery applies on orders over £40.

gifts-over-50.copy:
Luxury gifts are for the moments that matter: milestone birthdays, anniversaries and the people who deserve something special. This edit gathers 140 fragrances and skincare collections over £50, from niche extraits to designer classics.

Luxury perfume

Guerlain Oud Essentiel (125 ml, £94.99) is deep and elegant, Épices Exquises (£86.99) is warm and spicy, and Musc Noble (£74.99) is a smooth musk. Gucci Intense Oud (£73.99) is luxurious, Mancera Intense Red Tobacco Extrait (£79.99) is powerful and smoky, and Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Gold (£62.99) is rich and sensual. Giorgio Armani Code Eau de Toilette (125 ml, refillable, £66.99) and Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte (£55.99) round out the designer picks.

Sets to unwrap

La Maison de la Vanille's wooden coffret, Vanilles Des Origines (5 x 30 ml, £84.99), holds five vanilla scents in a keepsake box. anatomē's Parfum Travel (£125) is a discovery set made for travel, and The Gift of Good Sleep (£68) pairs a Somali Frankincense pillow spray with sleep care.

Skincare

A skincare gift set feels luxurious but practical. Highborn London's Ultimate Day & Night Moisture Set (£95) covers morning and night, and the Scrub and Glow Luminosity Set (£89) brings two natural products for brighter-looking skin.

Explore our niche perfume edit, the oud perfume page or the £50 and over range. Every gift is 100% authentic and ships from the UK, and because it's over £40, delivery is free.

diwali-gifts.copy:
Diwali gifts are about light, warmth and sharing something beautiful with the people you love. This edit gathers 92 perfumes and gift sets with rich oud, amber and rose notes, alongside natural Indian skincare from Deyga and Vilvah.

Warm, festive fragrance

Oud and amber feel right for the festival of lights. Al Haramain's Amber Oud Gold Edition (£29.99) is rich and sweet, the Ruby Edition (£41.99) is elegant, and Amber Musk (£39.99) is warm and smooth. Chopard Amber Malaki (£49.99) is a refined amber, and Chopard Oud Malaki (£48.99) is rich and sophisticated. For a showpiece, Tom Ford Oud Wood (£115.99) and Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh (£84.99) are memorable gifts. La Maison de la Vanille Royal Oud (£19.99) is a thoughtful, lower-cost choice.

Rose and floral

Rose is a lovely festive note. The Woods Collection Wild Roses (£44.99) is floral and woody, and the Bvlgari Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Gift Set (£79.99) comes ready to give with a 15 ml travel spray. Boucheron Rose d'Isparta (£63.99) is rich and elegant.

Natural skincare from India

A natural skincare gift set from Deyga or Vilvah brings the plants and rituals of Indian beauty to family and friends in the UK. Swansura is an official UK partner of Deyga and Vilvah. Browse their kits in our routines and sets or on the Deyga brand page.

See also our Oud fragrances family. Every gift is 100% authentic and posted from the UK, and delivery is free on orders over £40. Order early so your gifts arrive before the celebrations.

ramadan-eid-gifts.copy:
Ramadan and Eid gifts often centre on fragrance, from rich oud to soft musk. This edit brings together 64 perfumes from Arabian, niche and designer houses, chosen for warm, long-lasting notes that suit gatherings and visits.

Arabian houses

Al Haramain is a natural starting point. L'Aventure (£27.99) is fresh and confident, L'Aventure Blanche (£24.99) is crisp and clean, and L'Aventure Gold (£28.99) is elegant. Al Haramain Amber Musk (£39.99) is a smooth musk perfume, and Amber Oud Ruby Edition (£41.99) is rich and floral. La Maison de la Vanille Royal Oud (£19.99) is a thoughtful smaller gift.

Oud for him and her

For an oud perfume for men, Chopard Oud Malaki (£48.99) is rich and sophisticated, and Acqua di Parma Oud & Spice (20 ml, £40.99) comes in a compact size. For an oud perfume for women, Montale Aoud Damascus (£52.99) pairs oud with rose. Gucci Intense Oud (£73.99) and Tom Ford Oud Wood (50 ml, £124.99) are unisex showpieces.

Soft and refined

Not everyone loves heavy oud. Guerlain Musc Noble (£74.99) is a rich, smooth musk, Chopard Amber Malaki (£49.99) is warm amber, and Hemel Dorado (£49.99) is rich and sophisticated. Guerlain Habit Rouge (£64.99) is a timeless choice for men.

Explore our Arabian perfume page, the Oud range or the Al Haramain brand page. Every bottle is 100% authentic and sent from the UK, with free delivery over £40. Order in good time so gifts arrive before Eid.

scent-oud.copy:
Our oud perfume edit gathers 37 fragrances built on smoky, resinous agarwood, from £19.99 to £299.99. Arabian perfumers, European fashion houses and niche labels all interpret oud in their own way, so this page lets you compare them side by side. Every bottle is authentic and posted from the UK.

Arabian oud

Al Haramain is the largest name here, with its Amber Oud family: Gold Edition at £29.99, Ruby, Black, Carbon, Bleu, Tobacco and White editions, and Extreme Gold Edition Extrait de Parfum. Amber Oud White Edition is a lighter, women's take with citrus and soft florals. SAP Saffron Oud and Oud Leopard extraits, Fumeri Oud Saffron For Men and Korloff Royal Oud add more Arabian-style choice. Try our Amber Oud Discovery routine to compare three editions.

Niche and designer

Tiziana Terenzi brings extraits such as Gold Rose Oudh, Caput Mundi, Orion and the rare Dubhe Assoluto. Montale Aoud Damascus, a deep rose and oud women's fragrance, is a natural pick if you want an oud perfume for women, while Aoud Safran is bolder. Designer options include Tom Ford Oud Wood, Gucci Intense Oud, Guerlain Oud Essentiel and Chopard Oud Malaki. Whatever your budget, you can compare every style of oud perfume here, from a £19.99 La Maison de la Vanille Royal Oud to rare niche extraits.

Oud sits close to warm resins and spice, so you may also enjoy our amber fragrances or the Arabian perfume edit. Spend over £40 and UK delivery is free.

scent-amber.copy:
Our amber perfume edit gathers warm, sweet and golden scents that suit cooler evenings and close-to-skin wear. There are 34 fragrances from £19.99, mixing niche houses, Arabian perfumers and designer names. Every bottle is authentic and shipped from the UK.

Niche amber

Jo Milano has the deepest selection here. Game of Spades Full House is a unisex Eau de Parfum, Game of Spades Rouge comes in Parfum and Eau de Parfum, and Wildcard and Ruby complete the set. Swansura Selection Roll It 1 is a unisex Eau de Parfum at £99.99. Hemel Dorado brings spice, leather and florals, and Favourite Black adds citrus and aromatics.

Arabian and designer

Al Haramain Amber Musk is a warm, smooth unisex scent and a good choice if you want a musk perfume to wear daily, alongside Detour Noir. Signature D'orient Ambre, Fumeri Ambre Night and Chopard Amber Malaki also sit in this family. From the fashion houses, Dolce & Gabbana Devotion, Guerlain Habit Rouge, Joop! Homme Le Parfum and S.T. Dupont Royal Amber cover both men's and unisex styles. La Maison de la Vanille Ambre Secret and Absolu de Vanille are sweet vanilla ambers at £19.99.

If you love amber perfume, it pairs naturally with oud, so explore our oud fragrances next, or warm up a gift with the Amber Oud Evening routine. Orders over £40 travel free in the UK.
